doc: Adversarial wording cases for B's I7 filter (core.validator.wording_problems, B-013), written by D as red-team input. 'reject' cases break I7 for a reader: they reassure ('safe' or an equivalent) or tell the reader to start, stop or change a medicine. 'accept' cases are neutral clinical wording that should pass. 'by_design' marks cases B deliberately treats bluntly (B-013: any word containing 'safe' is rejected), so they are reported separately and not counted as false alarms. Texts are synthetic and illustrative.
